fact: A survey of all heads of department at Edward Francis Small Teaching Hospital, the national referral hospital, found that it operates primarily at the Initial/Ad Hoc stage of digital maturity, with fragmented systems and limited standardisation, and names electronic health records as an opportunity for phased integration rather than as a system in use.
title: Assessing the Current State of Digitalisation at the Edward Francis Small Teaching Hospital (EFSTH), The Gambia
publisher: AKSU Journal of Administration and Corporate Governance
